name: License Renewal and Expansion Agent
headline: Bring renewal risk and expansion evidence into one review
summary: Help account, customer-success, and sales leaders review renewal timing, account health, demand signals, churn evidence, and clearly labeled commercial scenarios before negotiation begins.
capabilities: Analyze customer health, feature adoption, usage spikes, and waitlisted demand
Compare competitive offers and calculate true switching costs
Identify credible expansion opportunities tied to user demand
Get a pricing and packaging strategy with pre‑approved concessions
value: Creates a shared renewal and risk review for sales and customer-success teams.
Makes demand and churn signals easier to connect to planning options.
Supports commercial scenario review without automating negotiation or outreach.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.title: Review the renewal pipeline
scenarios.prompt: Review the bundled synthetic renewal pipeline, risk bands, and preparation checklist without changing CRM or forecast records.

scenarios.title: Find expansion signals
scenarios.prompt: Identify synthetic demand signals and draft packaging options that still require authorized pricing review.

scenarios.title: Assess churn and switching risk
scenarios.prompt: Which synthetic accounts show churn or competitor risk, and what switching-cost assumptions require validation?

scenarios.title: Compare renewal scenarios
scenarios.prompt: Compare the bundled synthetic renewal, expansion, and churn scenarios without making revenue commitments.

scenarios.title: Account Executive: Strategic account analysis
scenarios.prompt: GlobalBank license expires in 45 days. Currently 2,000 seats at $1M ARR. Usage shows they need 500 more seats. Competitor offering 30% discount.

scenarios.title: Customer Success Manager: Competitive defense and switching costs
scenarios.prompt: Yes, show me the competitive defense strategy.

scenarios.title: Account Executive: Renewal and expansion proposal draft
scenarios.prompt: Yes, build the renewal and expansion proposal.

scenarios.title: Account Executive: Executive presentation outline
scenarios.prompt: Yes, create the executive presentation with talking points.

scenarios.title: Sales Leadership: Negotiation boundaries and approvals
scenarios.prompt: Yes, show me negotiation strategy and what approvals I need.

scenarios.title: Sales Leadership: Renewal strategy summary
scenarios.prompt: Yes, send the proposal and summarize our renewal strategy.
